title: Kao the Kangaroo: Round 2 (2003 re-release)
summary: Modern Steam re-release of a 2003 3D action-platformer focused on jumping, combat, exploration and collectible-driven levels, preserving the feel of an early-2000s platform game.

observations.statement: The available review evidence characterizes it as a straightforward retro 3D platformer whose modern release remains playable with contemporary controller support.
Nostalgia for the original release is a visible part of positive review sentiment.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index was sparse
